spec.studio_prompt: A modern three-seat minimalist sofa measuring 220 cm wide, 95 cm deep, and 80 cm high. Features wide, low-profile rectilinear block track arms and a continuous deep upholstered seat cushion with tailored edge welting. Constructed with a rectilinear backrest panel. Fully upholstered in a premium dove grey velvet (#a7a4a3, #716d6b, #d7d5d6) featuring a subtle, soft-nap texture and organic fabric shading. Built on a low-profile fully upholstered plinth base with clean, geometric proportions.
